purpose: Integrated reliability candidate: Watchdog resource fencing, guarded DEAD_LETTER supersession, and path-only shell/Git persistent write tracing.

compatibility.rule: A task may run only when its pinned registry, adapter, workflow, review-engine, and config-baseline versions satisfy an explicitly validated compatibility contract.

known_gaps: Write-path ownership and indirect side effects still require machine-checked coverage across all independent writers.
The declared review-engine version is not yet pinned to a verified source revision.
Resource ownership audit is still a partial static review; restore_automation_state is an additional serialized writer for source assessment history/report artifacts.

Review cursor checkpoint persistence is protected by the production workflow's top-level main-writer concurrency group and the live Watchdog fencing lease; complete transitive writer tracing remains outstanding.

Historical terminal tasks are resolved only when completed failure evidence proves their source SHA is superseded; unknown outcomes, current-main failures, active leases and unrelated task types remain untouched.

Path-only runtime traces now include Python filesystem audit events and persistent repository-tree deltas made by shell/Git child processes; transient write-and-revert activity, Git metadata changes, external filesystem/API effects, and unexecuted paths remain unobserved.
Durable per-URL assessment checkpoints are implemented in the task queue; live multi-run interruption/resume integration evidence is still pending.

Independent source discovery workflow and immutable run-bound artifact handoff are implemented on the integration branch but remain dormant until HOLD/authorization and monolithic cutover; no production dispatch has occurred.

required_before_independent_python_dispa: Validate executable entrypoints and argument schemas.
Declare read and write resource sets, including indirect writes.
Enforce exclusive resource leases for overlapping writers.
Record input snapshot hashes and output artifact hashes.
Verify config-baseline immutability before and after execution.
Run isolated canary tests with all new adapters disabled by default.
